hooks.name: Block reading .env files
hooks.description: Prevents the agent from reading .env files that contain wallet keys and API secrets.

action.command: cd /Users/udingethe/Dev/kleros && if echo "$KIRO_FILE_PATH" | grep -q "\.env$"; then echo "BLOCKED: Refusing to read .env file (contains secrets)" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
